_source: overhead 2/Sun.vb (module Lights: theTime, timeRatio, checkDayperiod, setDayColor, renderTime, renderDate), RECONSTRUCTION 6.1 to 6.3.

clock._note: theTime starts 64-01-01 09:00 and one in-game minute is added each time timeRatio x gameSpeed seconds pass (gameSpeed is heroes.json tuning.gameSpeed); at most one minute a tick, as renderTime added at most one a frame. The light starts at the starting period's colour (r, g, b all 255) and the period at Day; no announcement is made at the start, since checkDayperiod first runs at 9:01.

periods._note: 9:00am to 6:00pm. Each channel rises 1 a minute toward 255 (a channel above its target is set to it).
periods.name: Day

periods._note: 6:00pm to 9:00pm. Each channel falls 1 a minute toward (255, 128, 128) (a channel below its target is set to it).
periods.name: Evening

periods._note: 9:00pm to 6:00am. Red and green fall, blue rises, 1 a minute toward (128, 128, 255).
periods.name: Night

periods._note: 6:00am to 9:00am. Each channel rises 1 a minute toward 255.
periods.name: Morning

calendar._note: renderDate: the Gregorian month and weekday renamed (weekdays Sunday first, as .NET's DayOfWeek), and the year suffix.
